_comment: Tighten-only ledger of `unsafe` sites in first-party Rust (issue #842 W7.2). A count ABOVE its entry fails: new unsafe needs a deliberate, reviewed ledger bump. A count BELOW its entry also fails: the ledger must be lowered in the same change that removes the unsafe, so the ratchet can never silently slacken. Every unsafe site must additionally carry a `// SAFETY:` comment, which no ledger entry can waive.
_unblock: cargo is present in CI; this lane needs no extra tooling and always runs.
